name: Avery
self_text: I'm Avery, a Chilean man in my mid 20s. When I'm not watching old westerns, I spend my time on my handheld playing Hollow Lantern. I usually queue for ranked matches and communicate over text chat. I'm also happy to coach. I am free Saturday morning or Saturday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available on Saturday morning or Saturday afternoon, and it's a deal-breaker unless we overlap on text chat. It would be a small bonus if you are into ranked matches, but no big deal.
